name: Pinewood Technologies Group PLC
summary: Pinewood Technologies Group PLC provides cloud-native dealer management software solutions to the global automotive industry, including the United Kingdom market. The company offers a comprehensive, end-to-end platform engineered to enhance the efficiency of business processes for vehicle retailers. Formerly known as Pendragon PLC, the organization rebranded to Pinewood Technologies Group PLC in February 2024. Established in 1981, its headquarters are located in Nottingham, UK.
